title: Pleated pants for the office
summary: Gray to black · natural main fabric · no bootcut · any brand or fit.

recommendation.title: Best ready-made option: Hawes & Curtis
recommendation.text: Black pleated wool trousers, $160. Waist30 is selectable; the 36″ unfinished leg needs hemming to32″.
recommendation.test: Two $99.99 custom cotton alternatives below. Only one ready-made option verified—not four complete matches.

sources.title: Luxire · return terms
sources.note: Not normal free returns. Fit Guarantee says first remake on first order free within30 days, later/second remake50%; alterations for fit require customer shipping. Separate refund policy says custom items nonreturnable and first remake only orders<=100 plus both shipping costs. Conflicting policies need clarification.

sources.title: Luxire · fit guarantee conflict

Get written clarification; no risk-free claim.

sources.title: View Hawes & Curtis · Black Wool
sources.note: 100% wool; Super 100s twill. Size30 selectable, disabled=false; after click class=selected, Add to bag available. No cart or purchase submitted. Charcoal counterpart size30 is explicitly out of stock. Size30 selected on live page revealed 36 inch unfinished inseam. Must hem to32; NOT ready-to-wear30x32. Custom Length and Finish offered but price/configuration unverified. Hook-and-eye fastening disclosed; image shows belt loops/button closure. Lining, pocketing, thread and button composition not disclosed; do not claim whole garment plastic-free.

sources.title: Hawes & Curtis · return terms
sources.note: 28 days from receipt, original condition/tags; altered/customized items not returnable. International return handling fee calculated in portal and deducted from refund; amount not disclosed. No exchanges; refund and reorder. Return processing up to21 working days. Delivery policy additionally says sales tax non-refundable on returned items. Try unaltered before hemming.

sources.title: Hawes & Curtis · US delivery
sources.note: US policy: postal $17.95 /3-9 business days; standard $19.95 /3-5; express $22.95 /1-2. Import duties covered; sales tax at checkout. Altered items add4 working days. ZIP10016 checkout rate/date NOT verified. Product accordion advertises free shipping above$199, current banner and US delivery policy say above$249; this$160 item alone meets neither threshold.

caveat: Slim fit is no longer required. No lounge, flared or bootcut styles are recommended. Natural main cloth does not prove an entirely plastic-free garment: lining, thread and other trim materials remain unverified. No independent health benefit or exact-product safety certification established.
evidenceNote: Brand pages, selected size availability and product photos checked October14. Luxire pleats and a straight/tapered cut must be specified; folded stock photos do not establish the ordered silhouette. Exact customized prices, destination shipping and final tax were not verified. No purchase made. COS, Mango and Spier pages blocked verification; Uniqlo’s inspected option contained synthetics. These are bounded findings, not an exhaustive market claim.
